covers: rtext.c's GenImageFontAtlas (rows in order, the atlas made higher as it fills; glyphs clipped at its edges; the white corner; the skyline packer) and LoadFontFromImage's scan (a glyph to the image's right edge and bottom), as 6.2 has them, on glyphs and images made to reach those cases
notes: An atlas is printed as its size, format and a checksum of its texels; a font as its glyphs and their places.
